compute_feature_stats_for_dataset: compute feature statistics for a dataset using a pretrained feature detector model with caching support
compute_feature_stats_for_generator: compute feature statistics for a GAN generator by sampling random latent vectors and condition codes
get_feature_detector: load and cache a TorchScript feature detector model from a URL for multi-GPU distributed evaluation
FeatureStats_append: append numpy feature arrays to a FeatureStats object tracking mean, covariance, and all raw features
FeatureStats_get_mean_cov: retrieve the computed mean vector and covariance matrix from accumulated feature statistics
